verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser documents employer-side immigration work: a business client base of hospitals, manufacturers, multinationals and startups, an I-9/E-Verify employer compliance practice with audits and training, and a business O-1 practice page. Nothing in the pack names H-1B registrations or transfers, or LCA compliance, which are the core of this story. Missing for 10: documented H-1B registration and transfer services, LCA compliance service, explicit employer petition paperwork scope, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: Our business clients include hospital systems, large manufacturers, multi-national companies, mid-size family-owned businesses, tech companies, and entrepreneurial start-ups.
Siskind Susser attorneys are experts on I-9 and E-Verify compliance
